gr-xendit-7847359003.d:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

Why this role exists

Designing for developers is a distinct craft. The interface is often the dashboard, the API reference, the sandbox, the error states, and the logs, information-dense surfaces for a technical audience with little patience for friction. This role makes the developer's experience clear, fast, and trustworthy across those surfaces.

What you'll own

• Product design for the developer dashboard and integration surfaces.
• Information design for docs and API reference, in partnership with Engineering and content.
• Error states, empty states, sandbox and testing flows, the moments where developers get stuck.
• Discovery with developers, and close collaboration with the DevEx PM and Engineering.

How you will work

You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle and are embedded with the Developer Experience PM and Engineering as the design owner for developer-facing surfaces. You adopt and extend the domain design system rather than owning it, partnering with the senior design-system lead on shared patterns, so your time is weighted toward product work from the start. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.

What we're looking for

• Product-design craft with evidence of designing for technical, developer, or data-dense products. A portfolio is a must.
• Comfort with information-dense UI, dashboards, tables, complex states.
• The ability to partner closely with engineers. You work well alongside technical teams.

A strong plus: having designed docs, API reference, or developer tools; technical literacy; fintech experience.

Job Purpose :
To manage and optimize the performance of sales promotors across channels by ensuring effective deployment, capability development, performance tracking, and productivity monitoring to drive sales growth, product visibility, and customer advocacy

Main Responsibilities :

4. Ensure promotors execute advocacy process, sales campaigns, new product offering, and merchandising standards
5. Maintaining the relationship with third-party manpower agencies to ensure quality recruitments

Contract (C)

wo-jpfa-JR2899.d:
Job Summary**
Responsible for the safe and efficient transportation of eggs from the farm to designated locations within the PNGKLN LADA area, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to all traffic and company regulations.

Job Responsibilities**
* Operate a company-provided egg van in a safe and responsible manner, adhering to all traffic laws and company policies.
* Load and unload egg crates from the vehicle, ensuring proper handling to prevent damage.
* Verify the quantity and quality of eggs before departure and upon arrival, reporting any discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate delivery records and complete necessary paperwork.
* Conduct routine pre-trip and post-trip inspections of the vehicle, reporting any maintenance issues promptly.
* Adhere to biosecurity protocols and hygiene standards related to egg transportation.
* Communicate effectively with farm staff, customers, and supervisors.
* Ensure the cleanliness and tidiness of the delivery vehicle.

Job Qualifications**
* Valid driver's license (SIM B1 or B2) with a clean driving record.
* Proven experience as a delivery driver, preferably with experience handling perishable goods.
* Knowledge of routes and traffic regulations within the PNGKLN LADA area is highly desirable.
* Strong physical stamina and ability to lift and carry heavy loads.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* High level of responsibility and attention to detail.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including early mornings or weekends if required.
* Minimum education of High School Diploma or equivalent.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
